dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge, exhibiting a smooth spline from the apex to the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute, narrowly rounded apex with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin slopes posteriorly at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum vertical pixel height to base width is approximately 1.2:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Prominent convex melon with a consistent arc radius along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio protruding from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable interior angle of approximately 135 degrees where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single small, well-defined V-shaped notch is visible on the upper trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible dark ocular patch (eye) and a pectoral fin with a rounded leading edge and straight trailing edge.
